title: Hazel and the Horizon
author: Marguerite Crane
blurb: Lior Halloran, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent twenty years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
